# Integration Audit: LLaMA Factory

- Reviewed: 2026-07-23
- Used as architectural reference: yes
- Whole upstream tree copied: no
- Source ZIP retained: no
- Runtime dependency introduced: no
- Documentation set: one audit, one manifest, one readme, one license record

## Applied concepts

Reviewed its provider-agnostic model workflow, structured configuration, multimodal support, and separation of training/inference concerns. Applied the architectural principle of separating local deterministic generation from optional cloud blueprint refinement. No training framework code or model weights were copied.
